note: Beauty is the indoor value; outdoors it counts 30% of it (FilthRules.outdoorBeautyFactor). Cleanliness is the filth's own value in a cell, added to the floor's. Neither grows with thickness: thickness is how many cleaning passes the heap takes. cleanTicks are RimWorld ticks of work per layer at 100% speed; the sim converts them to game seconds. Under the open sky a layer goes after about the mean of filth.disappearsInDays (Filth::fadeHour), quicker in rain when rainWashes.

label: blood
note: filth.fadeSeconds (sneed, 2026-11-17, ours: RimWorld's blood lasts days): blood fades 3% every 10 real seconds at 1x from when it lands, so the pile is gone 10,200 game seconds (5 min 40 s) after it was last added to, indoors too. look (Unreal only, docs/design/blood.md): the colour fresh and after drying (about 5 real minutes), linear RGB. fluid: drawn as wet splats that dry.

label: insect blood
note: What chitinids bleed (Filth::bloodKindOf). Numbers as Blood.

label: machine fluid
note: Blue fluid that mechanical pawns leak when hit (sneed, 2026-11-16); RimWorld's mechanoids do not bleed. Numbers as Blood.

label: firefoam
note: Laid by a firefoam popper or foam turret; nothing catches fire on it. Fire.foamFadeStep thins it (FireRules.foamFadeHours).
